contamination_probe.question: What username do you log in with on a course virtual machine opened from the Colorado State CS VMware portal?

deciding_fact: the guest operating system of your virtual machine
key: create a new password at the first login
key_logic: An Ubuntu VM has no SNA-issued password; you set your own at the first login. A Windows VM requires the temporary password SNA provided when the VM was created; an invented password is rejected.
options: create a new password at the first login
enter the temporary password SNA gave you
question: What do you do at the Ubuntu VM's first password prompt?
recommended_option: create a new password at the first login
scripted_query: How do I log in to my course virtual machine for the first time?

source_a.heading: Instructions
source_a.highlight: you will have to create your password the first time you login.
source_a.label: A
source_a.page_text:
##### Instructions

Follow the instructions to login on the vmware portal and open a virtual machine in a browser window as discussed here

Once you have an Ubuntu VM open in a new window, proceed as per the screens below.

Login as the “vmuser”, you will have to create your password the first time you login.

Log out from the guest OS, and close the browser window.
source_a.title: Ubuntu VMs

source_b.heading: Instructions
source_b.highlight: you will have to provide a temporary password the first time you login.
source_b.label: B
source_b.page_text:
##### Instructions

Follow the instructions to login on the vmware portal and open a virtual machine in a browser window as discussed here

Once you have your Windows VM opened in a new window, proceed as per the screens below.

Login as the “vmuser”, you will have to provide a temporary password the first time you login. This must have been provided when the VM was created for you by SNA.
source_b.title: Windows VMs
